how: We read the website of every Washington DC wedding DJ listed on Lazo (47 listings, 36 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a national franchise's Frederick landing page, a national entertainment agency's DC page, party equipment rentals, AV companies, and DJs whose sites say almost nothing. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Do you bring a separate ceremony sound setup for an outdoor site with no power, and a lapel mic for the officiant?
Who exactly will be the DJ at my wedding, and what happens if they are sick that day?
What is the music cutoff at my venue, and does the quote include packing out by then, plus any bilingual or cultural music I need?

picks.name: Dominion Wedding Entertainment
picks.blurb: Dominion Wedding Entertainment pairs DJ and emcee services with lighting, monograms and photo booth experiences, and talks about pacing, announcements and transitions rather than just a playlist. The site says it has been recognized by WeddingWire every year from 2009 through 2026, working Northern Virginia, DC and Maryland.

picks.name: Wizer Productions
picks.blurb: Wizer Productions has grown over 30 years from a small family-run business into a Frederick production company serving more than 300 events a year, with DJs, lighting design, photo booths, photography and videography under one roof.

picks.name: DJ Jay ENT - Indian Wedding DJ Washington DC
picks.blurb: DJ Jay Singh, born and raised in Punjab, has over 15 years of South Asian and multicultural weddings behind him, blending Bollywood, Punjabi, Pakistani and Telugu music. DJ Jay Entertainment serves Virginia, Maryland and DC with intelligent moving-head lighting as part of the setup.

picks.name: Pulse Entertainment
picks.blurb: Karl Stallknecht, a Washington native, founded Pulse Entertainment in 2008 as a different kind of DJ and lighting company, built around customer service and consistency. The site walks through the history, the team, FAQs and recommended vendors before you ever ask for a quote.

picks.name: Knightrin Entertainment
picks.blurb: A boutique wedding DJ and luxury event production company in DC that fuses cultural competence and versatility to curate mixes across generations and cultures. Knightrin's pitch is an inclusive atmosphere from the first toast to the last song.

picks.name: Hercules Entertainment
picks.blurb: Hercules Entertainment, managed by Torrchez Entertainment in Woodbridge, provides bilingual Spanish and English DJs and MCs for weddings, quinceaneras and corporate events across DC and Northern Virginia. The site frames music as what sets the tone of the whole reception.

picks.name: Black Tie Entertainment – Top Rated DJs for Weddings, Corporate & Private Events in VA, DC & MD
picks.blurb: Black Tie Entertainment matches each couple to a DJ: you read the DJs' profiles, watch their personalized videos and the company pairs you. Its team commits to ongoing training for every DJ, MC and event specialist, serving Northern Virginia, DC, Maryland, Richmond and Charlottesville.

picks.name: Garcia Entertainment Group
picks.blurb: Oscar is the owner and DJ behind Garcia Entertainment Group, a bilingual wedding DJ and photo booth outfit with its own planning app. He builds the flow from your playlist and ideas, high energy from the first song to the last, across Virginia, Maryland and DC.

picks.name: Imani Entertainment DJ, Karaoke, and Photobooth Service
picks.blurb: Andy Yorke, DJ Hpnotiq, spent 21 years in radio, 16 of them on air at WHUR, WOL, WKYS and others, before building Imani Entertainment around DJ, karaoke and photo booth service. Pricing is printed: $1,500 for five hours with a two-to-four speaker setup covering ceremony, cocktail hour and reception, $200 per extra hour.

picks.name: Everything Entertainment
picks.blurb: Everything Entertainment began in 1998 and counts more than 10,000 events since across DC, Maryland and Northern Virginia, with weddings and mitzvahs at the core. Add-ons run from photo booths and prints to gaming, casino and VR.

picks.name: Planet DJ Productions
picks.blurb: Planet DJ Productions has been running parties since 1996 and specializes in Indian weddings in Virginia and Maryland, with the attitude that you do not last this long in the business by being mediocre. Equipment rentals are available as well.

picks.name: Soundtastic
picks.blurb: Mike Copen is the owner and sole DJ of Soundtastic, which means the person you talk to is the one at your reception. He lists discounts for active military, teachers and first responders, lets you check his availability and pricing online, and shares the site with Murphy the mascot.
